record.excerpt: The market makes a new 20day high or low and the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior. … The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker. … Buy entry is placed on the next day at the previous 20 day high/low watermark … Stop entries for failed trades are placed below the latest high/low that triggered the signal … Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals … OHLCV historical data for Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.
record.notes: Turtle Soup 20-day false-breakout rule on Binance BTC daily; exit window 2-6 bars is a range (compiler must pick).
